items.title: What’s next for the ISO net-zero standard
items.summary: If significant revisions are requested, an updated draft of the ISO net-zero framework must be circulated before a final approval vote can take place.

items.title: How the right language can convince skeptics to support corporate climate action
items.summary: Companies can expect consumer support for climate action — even from climate-skeptical Republicans — provided they talk about initiatives in the right way, according to a survey of 2,000 U.S. voters.

items.title: WWF launches coffee range with profits directed to nature conservation
items.summary: WWF has launched Earthbrew, a coffee range designed to support nature conservation through the profits generated from sales.

items.title: ECB accused of supporting fossil fuel companies tied to biodiversity loss
items.summary: A French think tank has accused the European Central Bank (ECB) of providing indirect financial support to companies whose fossil fuel operations are linked to biodiversity loss and damage to critical ecosystems.

items.title: EU solar power displaced €30bn of gas imports this year
items.summary: Solar power has saved Europe more than €30bn since the outbreak of the Iran War in avoided gas imports, SolarPower Europe has announced.

items.title: TODAY: Exploring the role of bio-based materials in lower-carbon buildings
items.summary: On 10 September, edie is hosting a new webinar exploring the growing interest in bio-based materials.

items.title: TISFD: Why businesses need a better way to understand people-related risk
items.summary: Businesses collect vast amounts of data on their people. Yet, the link between this information and concrete business performance remains frustratingly obscure.

items.title: ASA targets ‘eco’ claims from Thomas Cook, loveholidays and DialAFlight
items.summary: The Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) has called out the three travel agents for potentially misleading claims amid a wider crackdown on the sector.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: Practical actions to drive circularity across the business value chain
items.summary: In two weeks’ time, edie will hold its new webinar exploring how organisations can turn circular economy commitments into practical, measurable action across the business value chain.

items.title: Green groups criticise EU over water law overhaul
items.summary: Five environmental organisations, including Wetlands International Europe and WWF, have accused the European Commission of maladministration over its handling of a revision to the Water Framework Directive (WFD).
